name: Canada CPI Headline YoY (All Items, national)
notes: BoC Valet STATIC_TOTALCPICHANGE — 'Total CPI, percentage change year-over-year (unadjusted)', the official Canadian headline CPI inflation rate as published by the Bank of Canada. Registered 2026-07-30 as the national-primary CAN_CPI_YOY, displacing a DB.nomics relay of OECD COICOP2018 (third-hand). NOTE ON THE TRUE PRIMARY: Statistics Canada publishes NO headline CPI YoY vector — WDS cube 18100004 (1914-01 ->) is index-only and 18100256 carries only Bank-of-Canada core measures — so Canada's YoY can only be had second-hand or derived from the StatCan index. Verified live 2026-07-30 through sources/boc.py: 378 obs 1995-01 -> 2026-06 = 2.8, which is 2 MONTHS FRESHER than the OECD relay (2026-04); the relay stays tier 1 and extends the head 1915-01 -> 1994-12 under C16 (seam 0.0500pp). Trade-off accepted: BoC publishes to 1 decimal (the canonical published figure), the relay to full precision, hence the 0.0500pp = half-a-rounding-unit spread. See forward_plan §2.C C16.1 for the StatCan index-derived follow-up, which would beat both.
